claim: LP alone and both start pipelines attain target in every repeat on the same 54 of 72 cases.
assumptions: Synthetic panel; two-second timestamp gate; three repeats and all-repeat target.
falsifier: Find an admissible raw-LP failure or a grouped/repaired all-repeat target success on one of the remaining forced cases.

claim: Group start has no practical two-second advantage over LP-informed repair: forced cases 0 better, 11 ties, 7 worse.
assumptions: Prespecified 0.1% fallback-scale effect; case-median feasible costs, comparison within model.
falsifier: At matched budget, obtain increased all-repeat target attainment or a practical paired median improvement over repair and direct MILP.

claim: Five forced 12x16 case wins over direct full MILP coexist with losses against repair on all six cases of that size.
assumptions: Post-hoc size disaggregation of prospectively fixed 2-second paired endpoint; six cases only.
falsifier: Recompute case-specific practical differences from raw trajectories and input fallback scales.

claim: The full solver confirmed all 54 grouped-arm starts and 53 repair-arm starts; 31 and 37 were nonfallback respectively.
assumptions: Numeric HiGHS 1.12 start objective matched prior validated witness and full original model enforced.
falsifier: Find an incompatible restored full matrix vector or objective mismatch beyond 2e-5.

claim: All 18 forced root restrictions were declared infeasible by isolated presolve and the common original fallback passed in all cases.
assumptions: HiGHS presolve status is numerical; forced synthetic construction.
falsifier: Exhibit a physically feasible single-mode solution on one of these exact forced instances.

claim: Fresh W03 repeat recovered the 20/24 full/adaptive/LP-repair target counts and raw LP 18/24; endpoint costs varied against historical traces.
assumptions: Unmodified W03 generation and code; original reviewer fixed-clock tolerance; separate replay on shared host.
falsifier: Recompute all-repeat counts or recorded fixed-clock comparisons from the original and fresh W03 archives.

claim: Independent schedule replay agreed on 3019 retained witnesses and calculated 72 exact model LP box bounds.
assumptions: Binary64 coefficient model, direct dispatch tolerances; full MIP dual bounds are numerical.
falsifier: Find classification disagreement or an accepted primal cost below its exact LP bound beyond tolerance.
